# Stima Del Modello (ML) -------------------------------------------------------------------------


```{r}
df_train <- as.data.frame(X_train)
df_train$y <- y_train

df_test <- as.data.frame(X_test)
df_test$y <- y_test

fit_frequentist <- glm(y ~ ., data = df_train, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
summary(fit_frequentist)
```

# diagnostica delle osservazioni ---------------------------------------------------------------------

in parte è già stata fatta durante il pre-processing dei dati ma controlliamo nuovamente per sicurezza


# Inferenza -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Test di Wald

```{r}
summary(glm1)

# Wald CI
confint.default(glm1)

# Odds ratio e odds ratio CI
OR <- exp(coef(glm1))
CI_OR <- exp(confint.default(glm1))

cbind(
  OddsRatio = OR,
  Lower95 = CI_OR[, 1],
  Upper95 = CI_OR[, 2]
)
```

### Likelihood-ratio test (LRT)

test globale: solo intercetta

```{r}
glm_null <- glm(
  y ~ 1,
  data = df_train,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

anova(glm_null, glm1, test = "Chisq")
```

Test di un gruppo di variabili

```{r}
glm_no_late <- update(
  glm1,
  . ~ . -
    NumberOfTime30_59DaysPastDueNotWorse -
    NumberOfTimes90DaysLate -
    NumberOfTime60_89DaysPastDueNotWorse
)

anova(glm_no_late, glm1, test = "Chisq")
```

### Rao–Score test

```{r}
drop1(glm1, test = "Rao")
```

```{r}
anova(glm_no_late, glm1, test = "Rao")
```

### Devianza nulla, devianza residua e goodness-of-fit

nel summary sono riportate le quantità principali

```{r}
D_null <- glm1$null.deviance
D_res  <- deviance(glm1)

df_null <- glm1$df.null
df_res  <- df.residual(glm1)

c(
  NullDeviance = D_null,
  ResidualDeviance = D_res,
  Improvement = D_null - D_res,
  ResidualDF = df_res
)

# LRT globale from scratch
LR <- D_null - D_res
df_LR <- df_null - df_res
p_LR <- pchisq(LR, df = df_LR, lower.tail = FALSE)

c(LR = LR, df = df_LR, p_value = p_LR)
```

### X^2 Pearson

```{r}
X2_Pearson <- sum(residuals(glm1, type = "pearson")^2)
df_Pearson <- df.residual(glm1)

p_Pearson <- pchisq(X2_Pearson,df = df_Pearson,lower.tail = FALSE)

c(
  Pearson_X2 = X2_Pearson,
  df = df_Pearson,
  X2_over_df = X2_Pearson / df_Pearson,
  p_value = p_Pearson
)
```

### Calibration

```{r}
stopifnot(all(na.omit(unique(df_train$y)) %in% c(0, 1)))

calib_data <- data.frame(
  y = df_train$y,
  p = fitted(glm1)
)

# Dieci gruppi ordinati per probabilità prevista
calib_data$decile <- dplyr::ntile(calib_data$p, 10)

calibration <- aggregate(
  cbind(y, p) ~ decile,
  data = calib_data,
  FUN = mean
)

names(calibration) <- c(
  "Decile",
  "ObservedDefaultRate",
  "MeanPredictedRisk"
)

calibration
```

```{r}
plot(
  calibration$MeanPredictedRisk,
  calibration$ObservedDefaultRate,
  xlab = "Rischio medio previsto",
  ylab = "Frequenza osservata di default",
  main = "Calibration plot",
  pch = 19
)

abline(0, 1, lty = 2, col = "red")
```

# Prediction su TRAIN e TEST (ROC / PR-AUC) -----------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
# Probabilità a posteriori stimate
p_hat_train_freq <- predict(fit_frequentist, newdata = df_train, type = "response")
p_hat_test_freq <- predict(fit_frequentist, newdata = df_test, type = "response")
```

```{r}
train_metrics <- evaluate_classifier(
  y_train,
  p_hat_train_freq
)

print("Train metrics")
print(train_metrics)

test_metrics <- evaluate_classifier(
  y_test,
  p_hat_test_freq
)

print("Test metrics")
print(test_metrics)
```

# Threshold Tuning, Youden VS Cost-Sensitive

```{r}
roc_train_freq <- pROC::roc(
  y_train,
  p_hat_train_freq,
  quiet = TRUE
)

thr_youden <- youden_threshold(roc_train_freq)

thr_cost <- cost_sensitive_threshold(
  roc_train_freq,
  y_train,
  cost_fp = 1,
  cost_fn = 10
)

cat("Soglia Youden Index :", round(thr_youden, 4), "\n")
cat("Soglia Cost-Sensitive :", round(thr_cost, 4), "\n\n")
```

# Prediction OUT-OF-SAMPLE (TEST SET) e Evaluation

```{r}
df_test <- as.data.frame(X_test)
p_hat_test_freq <- predict(fit_frequentist, newdata = df_test, type = "response")

# Risultati Out-of-Sample
res_freq_youden <- evaluate_predictions(y_test, p_hat_test_freq, thr_youden, "Frequentist", "Youden Index")
res_freq_cost   <- evaluate_predictions(y_test, p_hat_test_freq, thr_cost, "Frequentist", "Cost-Sensitive")
```


```{r}
all_metrics_freq <- bind_rows(
  train_metrics %>%
    mutate(
      Dataset = "Train",
      Model = "Frequentist Logistic"
    ),
  
  test_metrics %>%
    mutate(
      Dataset = "Test",
      Model = "Frequentist Logistic"
    ),
  
  bind_rows(res_freq_youden, res_freq_cost) %>%
    mutate(
      Dataset = "Test_Thresholded",
      Model = "Frequentist Logistic"
    )
)

saveRDS(
  all_metrics_freq,
  "data/processed/metrics_frequentist.rds"
)
```
